Robotin R2 Pro: The World’s First Modular Carpet Washing Robot

The Future of Floor Care is Modular. Forget everything you know about robot vacuums. The Robotin R2 Pro is not just a vacuum; it is the world’s first fully autonomous modular cleaning system designed to solve the final frontier of home robotics: true deep carpet washing.

By bridging the gap between daily maintenance and professional-grade extraction, the R2 Pro adapts to your home’s changing needs. With a simple "snap-and-go" modular design, it transforms from a high-performance vacuum and mop into a dedicated carpet deep-cleaner that washes, scrubs, extracts, and dries your carpets, completely hands-free.

 

Key Features

Revolutionary Modular Design The R2 Pro features a swappable core architecture.

Mode A (Daily Clean): Attach the Vacuum & Mop Module for powerful 115AW suction and hard-floor mopping.

Mode B (Deep Clean): Swap in the Carpet Wash & Dry Module to convert the robot into a mobile carpet extractor. This isn't just surface wiping, it injects water, scrubs fibers, and extracts grime.

True Carpet Washing & Extraction Unlike standard robots that merely drag a wet cloth, the R2 Pro uses a 3-stage washing system:

Inject & Agitate: Sprays cleaning solution deep into the pile and scrubs with dual active brushes.

Extract: Powerful suction pulls out dirty water, allergens, and pet stains.

Hot Air Drying: Circulates 140°F (60°C) warm air to dry the carpet, preventing mold and odors.

The Ultimate All-in-One StationThe R2 Pro comes with a massive, automated base station. 

High-Capacity Tanks: 2.4-gallon clean water and 1.6-gallon dirty water tanks allow for coverage of up to 400 sq. ft. per cycle.
